title: Decoder input
description: One input to an adapter's decoder: the argument of decode(input). Producer: the adapter runtime (inputFromMessage in services/adapters/lib/decoder.cjs) from an MQTT packet, a webhook delivery handed off by the receiver, or one record of a polled page. Consumer: the adapter's JavaScript decoder in its sandbox, and the portal's decoder test, which builds the same input from a fixture. Delivery: at least once. An MQTT or webhook input is acknowledged only after its results are published, deduplicated or recorded as failed, so the source redelivers after a restart; a polled page's cursor moves only after every record is settled. Deduplication key: none on the input; the decoder's messageId per adapter and source device deduplicates the results for 7 days (decoder-output.v1). Field names are camelCase because this is the JavaScript decoder API, not a platform message. The wire has no schema_version: the input is an existing format, and spec 020 added `source`, `http` and `poll` additively (contracts/README.md). Not expressible here: the input is at most 8 MiB as JSON, and the decoder source at most 64,000 characters.

payload.description: The body parsed as JSON: any JSON value, or null when the body is not JSON.

bytes.description: The raw body, at most 1 MiB.

topic.description: MQTT: the packet's topic. Webhook: the sub path below the ingest URL, empty when none. Poll: empty.

receivedAt.description: MQTT and webhook: when the platform received it. Poll: when the page arrived.

qos.description: Webhook deliveries are handed off at 1.

http.description: The webhook delivery: always present for source webhook, absent otherwise.

path.description: The path below the ingest URL with the URL token removed; empty when there is none.

query.description: Query parameters; a repeated name has an array of values.

headers.description: Lower-case header names, without the authentication and signature headers, authorization, cookie, forwarded, x-forwarded-* and x-real-ip.

poll.description: The polled record's position: always present for source poll, absent otherwise.

index.description: Position of the record in its page.

cursor.description: The cursor the page was requested with; null before the first one.
